entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Drago Perović was a Croatian doctor who served as a professor of anatomy and as rector at the University of Zagreb. He established an influential school of osteology dealing particularly with the ear, nose and throat.

entities.summary: Drago Perović was a Croatian doctor who served as a professor of anatomy and as rector at the University of Zagreb. He established an influential school of osteology dealing particularly with the ear, nose and throat.
